li_projects.title: NutriScan AI
li_projects.description: NutriScan AI is an AI-powered nutrition assistant my team and I built in 36 hours at HackWestern 12. It lets users snap a photo of their meal or log items manually, then uses the Google Gemini API to estimate calories, macros, and key nutrients while giving simple, personalized guidance instead of raw numbers. The app combines an onboarding questionnaire with ongoing meal scans and daily check-ins

posts.text: Over this past weekend I had the opportunity to spend 36 hours at HackWestern 12 building NutriScan AI with Shayaan Tanvir, Mohammad Hammad, and Ziad Elnagar.
